name: Sing
overview: Scripture reveals singing as a heartfelt response to God's strength, help, and deliverance, expressing joy and praise to the Most High. The Psalms call believers to sing psalms and make a joyful noise, celebrating God's wondrous works and faithfulness. Even in times of past anger, as Isaiah shows, God's comfort inspires praise and singing, highlighting the believer's trust and rejoicing under His protection.
